correctness.rationale: The two source-defined principal eigenproblems have the same simple homogeneous eigenpair. Centering removes first-order eigenvalue changes. Both normalized first corrections solve -g0 Delta u = (gamma0/beta0)b-r. Integrated second-order expansions show a shared resolvent contribution and exactly (g1/g0)mean(rq)/beta0 additional to the Fokker-Planck inverse reproduction eigenvalue. Reciprocal expansion yields the theorem. Both strict opposite invasion examples have exact quadratic coefficients of opposite sign. The extracted numerical Galerkin checker passes, but is only supplementary.

value.rationale: Directly addresses the source-identified difficulty of comparing two epidemic invasion thresholds in heterogeneous settings. The domain-independent covariance formula clarifies the mechanism, while paired exact examples show that selecting the mobility law can reverse whether the deterministic disease-free equilibrium resists invasion. The result is a structural classification at the leading nontrivial order rather than a routine isolated calculation.
